validity_findings.finding: Full fingerprint includes sorted_filtered_headers by construction, so any change in included headers necessarily changes hash (1.0 discrimination is architecturally forced when headers differ). This is the intended test of header inclusion vs Content-Length correlation, not a circularity flaw.
